data.title: From signal to momentum
data.subtitle: A cross-channel product performance review
data.intro: This deliberately ordinary business story is rendered four different ways. The content stays fixed; the brandbook controls the visual system, cover treatment, hierarchy, colour, logo, chart palette, spacing and density.

charts.title: Weekly active teams
charts.subtitle: A steady climb after the spring release

sections.heading: The product is becoming a habit
sections.body: The strongest signal is not a single campaign spike. Teams that complete the first workflow return more often, invite colleagues sooner and create a larger share of qualified expansion opportunities.

sections.heading: The next unlock is clarity
sections.body: The opportunity for the next cycle is to make the value of automation visible earlier. A shorter path from first result to shared team ritual should improve both activation and retention.
